webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Jelee sends signed HTTPS requests to these endpoints when events happen. Each request carries an HMAC-SHA256 signature made with the endpoint's secret.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add an endpoint to be notified of library, scan, sign-in and system events.
webhooks.deletePrompt: Deletes {name} and its delivery log. This cannot be undone.

form.name: Name
form.urlHint: HTTPS only, without credentials. Private and local addresses are refused.
form.urlInvalid: Enter an address that starts with https://.
form.timeoutInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30.
form.eventsHint: Leave all unchecked to receive every event.
form.headersHint: Values are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
form.replaceHeadersHint: Unchecked keeps the stored headers. Checked with no rows removes them all.
form.headerInvalid: Each header needs a unique, non-empty name.
form.invalid: The server refused these settings. Check the URL, events and header names (reserved names such as Content-Type or X-Jelee-* are not allowed).

secret.title: Signing secret of {name} — shown only once
secret.body: Copy it now and store it with the receiving service. It cannot be shown again; if it is lost, rotate the secret to get a new one.
secret.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the secret above and copy it by hand.

rotate.title: Rotate secret
rotate.hint: Creates a new signing secret. During the grace period deliveries are also signed with the old one, so receivers can switch without failures.
rotate.grace: Grace period for the old secret
rotate.prompt: After the grace period only the new secret signs deliveries; update the receiver before then.

detail.title: Webhook: {name}
detail.previousSecret: The previous secret still signs until {date}.

deliveries.title: Delivery log
deliveries.resendPrompt: The receiver gets this event again with the same eventId ({eventId}); make sure it handles duplicates.
